“the stakes for our coverage has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our coverage have never been higher”

“the federal goverment's next steps” >>> “the federal government's next steps”

“matters more then ever” >>> “matters more than ever”

“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named]

“but it's definitions are broad” >>> “but its definitions are broad”

“its central principal is a prohibition” >>> “its central principle is a prohibition”

“In brief, the bill:” >>> “In brief:”

“the bill's enforcment regime” >>> “the bill's enforcement regime”

“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OH)” / “Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield’s state is inconsistent]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: the earlier summary says Section 5 sets a maximum civil penalty of $1 million per day]

“Senator Grant, who's support” >>> “Senator Grant, whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”

“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: these categories total 29, not 28]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow.” >>> [CHECK: only five senators are listed, although the preceding sentence says six are undecided; Ames is later also described as undecided]

“the markup on Thursday, October 14” >>> “the markup on Thursday, October 15”

“after the September 23 hearing” >>> [CHECK: the timeline identifies the committee’s advanced-AI hearing as occurring on September 30]

“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached.” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached.”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“the week November 16” >>> “the week of November 16”

“advanced AI occured on September 30” >>> “advanced AI occurred on September 30”

“would have to conclude within two years” >>> “would have to conclude within 18 months”

“is a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “is a close complement to S. 2817”

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“reaching out to there senators” >>> “reaching out to their senators”

“you should recieve updated notes” >>> “you should receive updated notes”

“Our six Hill reporters” / “Each of our five Hill reporters” >>> [CHECK: the number of Hill reporters is inconsistent]
